[EVENT] User rented an RV and drove from California for their last trip to Yellowstone.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in family-friendly accommodations and activities in Yellowstone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Canyon Lodge & Cabins is recommended as a family-friendly accommodation option.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Grant Village and Yellowstone Gateway Inn are also recommended accommodations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested activities include guided tours, visiting Upper and Lower Yellowstone Falls, exploring Yellowstone Lake, Mammoth Hot Springs, and participating in ranger programs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for planning include booking early, checking the park's website for updates, packing wisely, and scheduling breaks.  
[EVENT] User expressed interest in tips for keeping kids occupied during long drives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for keeping kids occupied during long drives include audiobooks and podcasts, road trip bingo, car games, tablets and handheld games, snack stations, pit stops, scavenger hunts, car karaoke, travel journals, and taking turns.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in seeing geysers and hot springs during their trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Old Faithful is recommended as a must-see geyser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other geysers suitable for kids include Grand Geyser, Castle Geyser, and Daisy Geyser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended hot springs include Mammoth Hot Springs, Norris Geyser Basin, and Boiling River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for spotting bears include knowing their habitats, being active in the early morning and late evening, keeping a safe distance, looking for signs, and driving slowly while scanning the landscape.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Best areas to spot bears include Lamar Valley, Slough Creek, Tower-Roosevelt Area, and Mammoth Hot Springs.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in exploring the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone River.  
[PREFERENCE] User is fascinated by the geology of the area.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended hiking trails in the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone River include Brink of Lower Falls Trail, Seven Mile Hole Trail, and South Rim Trail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Brink of Lower Falls Trail is a 3/4-mile round-trip trail to the brink of the Lower Yellowstone Falls.
